title: Hypnotic Melting Clown Ritual
description: A surreal painting shows a line of women in patterned blue dresses holding roses while standing before black and white hypnotic spiral backdrops. Above them, a large melting cartoon clown face with spiral eyes drips magenta liquid onto old televisions attached to thorny green trees.
prompt: Surreal painting of a row of women wearing blue patterned dresses and holding red and purple roses, standing in front of black and white hypnotic spiral patterns. Thorny green trees separate the scenes. A giant melting cartoon clown with spiral eyes and an orange smile drips thick magenta liquid from the top of the canvas onto vintage televisions mounted on the trees, vibrant blue sky background, detailed symbolic composition
